Miners smashed: SILJ −5.44% to $29.40, GDX −4.36% to $93.56, GDXJ −5.23%, SIL −5.33%; gold −1.8% (GLD proxy, est ~$4,300–4,320). Driver: UST 10y +15bp to 5.12% — highest since 2007 on hot flash PMIs, hawkish Iran comments, AI supply and a 3.1bp 5yr tail. US equities fell (S&P 7,706.03 −0.75%, Nasdaq 26,936.04 −1.13%); HK trimmed (HSI −1.57% below 25k; Tencent −2.35% but held the ~439 tell at its 438.60 low).
  • The one thing: summit day. Xi landed at Joint Base Andrews ~6pm ET and Trump personally greeted him at the airport — a ~60-year protocol break. Main meetings today, state dinner tonight with the US tech-CEO bench (Huang, Cook, Musk, Zuckerberg, Altman, Nadella, Pichai, Bezos, Dimon, Fraser, Dell) and no Chinese CEOs. Core deliverable: truce extension (expires Nov 10); rare earths, AI, Taiwan red lines, Iran. Expectations managed to incremental progress — and the market de-risked before the binary, lowering the bar for a relief rally.

trumpWatch.title: SUMMIT DAY: Xi lands at Andrews; Trump personally greets him at the airport — ~60-year protocol break
trumpWatch.detail: Xi arrived ~6pm ET Wednesday; visit runs Sep 23-25 with a full state arrival ceremony Thursday (479 troops), main meetings Thursday Sep 24 and the 'G2 Summit' state dinner tonight. US CEO bench attending: Huang, Cook, Musk, Zuckerberg, Altman, Nadella, Pichai, Bezos, Dimon, Fraser, Dell — Xi brought NO CEOs. US goods trade Jan-Jul 2026: exports $65.2bn, imports $156.4bn.

trumpWatch.title: Agenda: truce extension is the core deliverable (expires Nov 10); rare earths, AI, Taiwan 'red lines', Iran
trumpWatch.detail: China wants a longer truce extension, the US prefers shorter; rare earths are China's leverage; Xi to ask Trump to stop Taiwan arms sales (ambassador Xie Feng: Taiwan and human rights are 'red lines'); US wants Chinese pressure on Tehran (Xi reluctant); ag purchases and aircraft sales also on the table. Officials: Lutnick, Bessent, Wright, Greer. Expectations deliberately managed to 'incremental progress'.

trumpWatch.title: Rates shock: UST 10y +15bp to 5.12% — highest since 2007
trumpWatch.detail: Hot S&P Global flash PMIs (fastest private-sector expansion in 5+ years, inflation pressures accelerating on both sides), hawkish Iranian-leader comments dimming diplomacy hopes, heavy corporate supply (AI issuers over $1.5T YTD) and a 3.1bp tail in the 5yr auction. 30y at 5.40%. The Wednesday rate shock is the summit day's master variable.

trumpWatch.title: Metals washout: SLV -4.23% to $58.16, GLD -1.80% — 'Fed hike bets firm'
trumpWatch.detail: Kitco AM (Wed): 'Gold, silver slide as dollar rallies and Fed hike bets firm'; FXEmpire: 'Gold Drops Below $4300 As Traders Bet On Hawkish Fed'. Miners hit harder: SILJ -5.44%, GDX -4.36%, GDXJ -5.23%. Tuesday's 'silver leads metals higher' reversed in one session; silver spot est ~$64.3 — back at the top of the $62-64 reload zone.

trumpWatch.title: US-Iran: delegations met 3 hours on UNGA sidelines — Trump: 'very constructive'; Zelensky ready for energy truce with Russia
trumpWatch.detail: Trump described the 3-hour US-Iran meeting as 'very constructive' with more contacts soon; separately Zelensky signalled readiness for an energy truce with Russia after talks with Trump. Diplomacy tracks continue in parallel with the summit.

trumpWatch.title: Today's slate: Xi-Trump main meetings + state dinner; Riksbank/SNB/Norges/Banxico; Japan flash PMI; German IFO; US claims
trumpWatch.detail: Newsquawk flags the Chinese president's state visit as 'the higher-beta item' among four central-bank decisions, Japan's flash PMI, German IFO and US initial jobless claims. Mainland China is on Mid-Autumn holiday Friday — HK trades but southbound flows shut.

The driver this time is rates (10y 5.12%, highest since 2007), not thesis — the physical deficit, India imports (+127% y/y) and CME 24/7 story are intact.
